description: Player 1's deck for spec 43 (#991, SPEC §10.10, R280, R583, R1447). C+ #44 Simplicity Audit is in it because its Radiant preview names the permanents it would exile now (R583). #8 Mr. Vanilla (1 mana, fewer lines of code than the Audit) is the one permanent it will count. #26 Glowy Jelly Bean (3 mana) makes the Audit Radiant in hand. #19 Midrange Menace, #25 4-mana 7/7 and #53 Reno cost 3 or more and do nothing from a hand. The handicap (R180) gives an opening hand of 3 + 2 = 5, and player 1's turn-1 draw makes 6: the whole deck on any seed. 1 + 5 mana under a cap of 6 is 6 mana on turn 1. Vanilla and the Bean cost 4, and the 2 left keep the 2-mana Audit playable, so the turn does not end by itself (R82).
